headline: Philippine Inflation Accelerates to 7.2% in September
seoDescription: PSA data show Philippine inflation accelerated to 7.2% in September 2026 as food, housing costs and transport rose faster.
deck: Food inflation reached 6.8%, rice inflation hit 20.3%, and the nine-month headline average rose to 5.4%.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What changed
paragraphs: Philippine headline inflation accelerated to 7.2% in September 2026 from 6.1% in August, the Philippine Statistics Authority reported on October 6. The January-to-September average rose to 5.4%, while core inflation increased to 4.7% from 4.1%.

Inflation was 5.4% in Metro Manila and 7.6% outside the capital region. The PSA identified faster price increases in food and non-alcoholic beverages, housing and utilities, and transport as the main drivers.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: National food inflation rose to 6.8% from 4.6%. Rice inflation reached 20.3%, while the vegetables, tubers, plantains, cooking bananas and pulses index increased 10.7% after declining 3.4% in August.
The national figure is an average. Actual household pressure varies with location, income and spending patterns, and the data do not mean every item rose by 7.2%.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Faster food, transport and utility inflation reduces purchasing power, especially for lower-income households that devote a larger share of spending to essentials. It can also complicate interest-rate and wage decisions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch the next PSA inflation release, food supply and retail rice prices, fuel costs, and any response from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas or economic managers.
